title: Private Chat
description: Private direct messages for Minecraft servers with notifications, quick reply, DND mode, and a clean UI.
body: ## 📬 Private Chat **Private Chat** adds modern direct messages (DMs) to Minecraft multiplayer servers with a clean UI and instant notifications. When another player messages you, you receive an **in-game pop-up notification with sound** — so you never miss a message while playing. Open the private chat menu using the **Y key** (fully configurable), select a player from the online list, and start chatting privately. Unread messages are clearly marked with a **green dot**, and you can instantly reply using the **R key**. The mod also includes **Do Not Disturb (DND)** mode and **player muting**, giving you full control over your private conversations. --- ## ✨ Features - Private 1-to-1 direct messages - In-game notification popups with sound - Open private chat menu with **Y** (configurable keybind) - Quick reply using the **R** key (configurable keybind) - Do Not Disturb (DND) mode - Mute / unmute specific players - Unread message indicator (green dot) - Simple, clean UI with online player list --- ## 🕹 How It Works 1. Receive a private message → get notified instantly. 2. Press **R** to quick-reply, or press **Y** to open the private chat menu. 3. Select a player and chat privately. 4. Enable **DND** to block interruptions when needed. Designed for multiplayer servers where private communication matters. --- ## 🖼 Screenshots **Incoming private message notification** Get notified instantly when another player sends you a private message. ![message notification](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b9a0600b03b43008b22f897a9a037119d44b6dd9_0.webp) **Private chat menu with online players** Open the DM menu to see online players and unread messages (green dot). **Private conversation view** A clean and focused chat view for private conversations. ![Private chat menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4c32bc5534b2a75705abe0da0853d3f870c7e713_0.webp) **Quick reply popup** Reply instantly using the **R** key without opening the full menu. ![Quick reply popup](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49447edee8771f0a9ff53f2aca0ee7ad8f2fc979.png) ---
